_comment: Tripwires, not targets. A pin that trips one of these has observed a ports
commit that does not match what upstream actually published, or a ports
overlay change landed without a pin refresh. Either way a human should look
before the build spends hours acting on it.
Measured at ports commit 5052095e: amd64 delta 92, mirror 516, churn 3;
arm64 delta 95, mirror 458, churn 32. arm64 lags upstream further, which is
structural and why each architecture observes its own ports commit.
